page.layout: One printed page, single text column, with two marginal notes in the left margin. Running head at top, page number at top left. Catchword at right below the last line. The strip of the facing page at the right edge is not transcribed.

main_text.p: Ruffiæ Albæ caput Urbs Mo-scovia facta.
Circa A. C. 1315 Daniel Dux Rufforum sedem Imperii ex urbe Wolodimiria Moscoviam transtu-lit; à quo tempore & Ruffia Mosco-via, & Ruffæ Moscovita appellan-tur.
main_text.head: Explicatio:
main_text.p: Qvippe Johannes Basilides Magnam Novogardiam A. C. 1477 occupavit, ejusq; Successor Basilius A. C. 1518 provincias Glaciali Oceano vicinas usq; ad fluvium Obij & Novam Cemblam occupavit. Ducatus quoq; Smolensco & Plescoviæ expugnavit, unde Tzar, i e. Imperator dictus fuit. Sub Johanne Basilide II

page.notes: Marginal "§" is read as a section sign, uncertain. Right-edge fragments belong to the facing page and were left out. "1315" is read from a damaged numeral and may be misprinted. "Rufforum" is printed as shown, possibly for "Russorum". "Explic." and "Explicatio:" are treated as labels; "Explicatio:" is set as a level 2 head. "Canon 3." and "Canon 4." are kept as paragraphs per the rules for numbered canons.
